faq.q: How do I check if a Chilliwack lot is in the ALR?
faq.a: The City directs owners to the City Webmap to check ALR status; ALR properties are subject to the Agricultural Land Commission Act and regulations, and an ALC application may be required for a new house, fill or soil removal, a non-farm use, or a subdivision or boundary adjustment.

faq.q: Can a serviced Chilliwack lot carry more than one home?
faq.a: The City's SSMUH amendment, Zoning Bylaw Amendment Bylaw 2024, No. 5395 (adopted June 18, 2024), allows 3 to 4 dwelling units on parcels within the urban growth boundary zoned for single-detached and duplex housing, per the City's staff-report description — eligibility is parcel-specific and is confirmed with the City.

faq.q: What permit areas should I check on a hillside lot?
faq.a: The OCP's Schedule D lists D-2 Hillside Environment and D-5 Hillside Development among its development permit areas, along with D-1 Drinking Water Supply and D-3 Riparian Area; which areas apply to a specific lot is a per-parcel check with the City. Note the current OCP list does not use the live page's "DPA2 (Hillside and Upland)" name.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Chilliwack Lots & Land?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
